summary: Ramin Etesami is a scholar in Buddhist studies who earned a Master of Arts at the International Buddhist College, attested in 2015, under supervisors Lobsang Jamspal and Krishna Ghosh Della Santina.

Ramkrishna Gopal Bhandarkar (1837–1925) was an Indologist and linguist. He studied at Elphinstone College, the University of Mumbai, with Martin Haug, and at the University of Göttingen. He taught at Deccan College (~1882–1893) and Elphinstone College (attested 1907).
Ramón Prats is a Tibetologist who held posts at Himalayan and Inner Asian Resources (attested 1999) and Pompeu Fabra University (attested 2017).
Randall Studstill works in religious studies and philosophy. He studied under teacher Steven D. Goodman and completed his doctoral work under the supervision of Richard K. Payne.

Rangama Chandawimala is a scholar in Buddhist studies. He studied under traditional teacher Attaragama Gnanawimala and completed a PhD at the University of Hong Kong, supervised by Jing Yin and co-supervised by Kakkapalliye Anuruddha.

Rangjung Rigpe Dorje (1924–1981) was a figure in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied under the 13th Dalai Lama, Tai Situ Pema Wangchok Gyalpo, Dzongsar Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö, and Kalu Rinpoche, and taught numerous students.
Raniero Gnoli (1930–2025) was a scholar in Indology and Buddhist studies who studied under Giuseppe Tucci. He held a post at Sapienza University of Rome from circa 1964 to 2000.
Raoul Birnbaum is a scholar of Buddhist studies and sinology who served as a professor of Buddhist studies at the University of California, Santa Cruz (attested 2003 and 2017).

Rasiklal Chhotalal Parikh (1897–1982) worked in Indology and history/archaeology. He studied at Fergusson College and under Sukhlal Sanghvi, later serving as secretary at Gujarat Puratattva Mandir and professor at Gujarat Vidyapith.

Rasmus Rask (1787–1832) was a Danish linguist and Indologist. He studied at the University of Copenhagen from circa 1807 to 1812 and later served there as Professor of Literary History and Librarian from circa 1825 to 1832.

Ravindra Singh Bisht (born 1944) works in history, archaeology, and Indology. He studied at the University of Lucknow and served as Director General of the Archaeological Survey of India from circa 1999 to 2004.
Rawi Bhavilai (1925–2017) was a scholar of Buddhist studies and philosophy who studied at the University of Adelaide and served as a director at Chulalongkorn University (attested 2002).

Rebecca Redwood French works in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. She studied at the University of Washington and Yale University, mentored by several scholars. She held posts at the University of Colorado Boulder (1996–2003) and University at Buffalo (attested 2014).

Regbi Pubaev (1928–1991) worked in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied at St. Petersburg University (~1947–1952) and held posts at Buryat State University and the Institute of Mongolian, Buddhist and Tibetan Studies (~1958–1991).

Reginald A. Ray (born 1942) works in Buddhist and religious studies. He studied under numerous academic and traditional teachers. He taught at the University of Colorado Boulder (attested 2001–2002) and Naropa University (attested 2001–2006).
Rei Yoshimura (1929–2013) was a scholar in history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies. He studied at Waseda University and served as a professor there from circa 1975 to 2000.

Reiko Ohnuma (born 1964) works in Buddhist studies, religious studies, and Indology. She studied at UC Berkeley and earned her PhD at the University of Michigan. She held posts at UT Austin, the University of Alabama, and Dartmouth College.

Reimon Yuki (1902–1992) was a Buddhist studies and philosophy scholar who studied at the University of Tokyo (~1923–1927). He taught at the University of Tokyo (~1949–1963), Ryukoku University (~1963–1973), and Kyoto Women's University (~1973–1983).
Reiner Wiehl (1929–2010) was a philosopher who held academic posts at the University of Hamburg from circa 1970 to 1977 and at Heidelberg University from circa 1977 to 1997.
Reinhold Grünendahl is an Indologist who held posts at the Free University of Berlin (attested 1983) and the Göttingen State and University Library (attested 2008).
